build_tree_from_dumpsys_output: build a tree from Android dumpsys output by parsing indented text into a hierarchical node structure
test_build_tree_from_dumpsys_output: test that build_tree_from_dumpsys_output correctly parses an indented hierarchy into a rooted tree with children
test_matches_path: test that matches_path finds a regex-defined path within a dumpsys view hierarchy tree
test_wait_for_app_screen_zero_timeout: test that AppScreenChecker raises WaitForAppScreenError when timeout is zero seconds
test_wait_for_app_screen_successful: test that AppScreenChecker returns successfully when the expected activity matches the current activity
